recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-30091. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for this seed; related target-profile changes should remain governed by their later Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-30091 was a Published/Persuasive BRR R5 change request to add a 0..* ResearchStudy results element with datatype Reference(EvidenceReport), enabling studies to link to generated results or registries such as ClinicalTrials.gov.
initial_application: Commit 4ee3d88453e88c357488b3f6ba238e7ae1ce44bb initially applied the request by adding ResearchStudy.results 0..* Reference(EvidenceReport) with the requested definition text. Commit 9175459a6ea354d82e8b09ca90574344bbe333d6 then applied the related FHIR-31040 target broadening to DiagnosticReport and Citation.
additional_context: The current build uses singular element naming as ResearchStudy.result. ResearchStudy is active in source/fhir.ini, while EvidenceReport is no longer an active core resource. Later R6 decisions added Composition because EvidenceReport was being deprecated/replaced, added Evidence, removed Citation from core, and added DocumentReference as a current linking option.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source already has ResearchStudy.result 0..* Reference with the results-linking definition and current targets Composition, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, and Evidence; re-adding EvidenceReport or reverting to the old plural element name would conflict with later current-build decisions.
